content:
This project builds an Enterprise‑Scale Knowledge Graph by fusing tabular records, textual logs, and network data entirely in Pandas, augmented with graph analytics, NLP embeddings, temporal features, and anomaly detection pipelines for actionable insights. The code leverages Dask for scalability, NetworkX and Faiss for graph operations, HuggingFace transformers for text, PyOD for outlier detection, and integrates real‑time streaming hooks. (GeeksforGeeks, upGrad, arXiv, Acceldata)

# Project Title: ai-ml-ds-SrmKGGraph001
# File Name: advanced_knowledge_graph_construction_and_anomaly_detection_with_pandas.py

import pandas as pd  # type: ignore
import dask.dataframe as dd  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import networkx as nx  # type: ignore
import faiss  # type: ignore
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler  # type: ignore
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA  # type: ignore
from sklearn.cluster import DBSCAN  # type: ignore
from pyod.models.iforest import IForest  # type: ignore
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, TFAutoModel  # type: ignore
from joblib import dump, load  # type: ignore
from datetime import datetime as dt

# 1. Simulate Multimodal Inputs
def simulate_data(n_records: int = 5000) -> pd.DataFrame:
    ts: pd.DatetimeIndex = pd.date_range(start=dt(2025,1,1), periods=n_records, freq='T')
    df_tab: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame({
        'ts': ts,
        'user_id': np.random.randint(1,200,n_records),
        'activity_count': np.random.poisson(5, n_records),
        'rating': np.random.uniform(1,5, n_records)
    })
    df_txt: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame({
        'ts': ts,
        'log': np.random.choice(['error','warn','info','debug'], n_records)
    })
    df_net: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame({
        'ts': ts,
        'src': np.random.randint(1,200,n_records),
        'dst': np.random.randint(1,200,n_records)
    })
    return df_tab, df_txt, df_net

# 2. Preprocessing & Embeddings
def preprocess_and_embed(df_tab: pd.DataFrame, df_txt: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Merge streams
    df: pd.DataFrame = pd.merge_asof(df_tab.sort_values('ts'),
                                     df_txt.sort_values('ts'), on='ts')
    # Scale numerics
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    df[['activity_count','rating']] = scaler.fit_transform(df[['activity_count','rating']])
    # Text embeddings
    tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('distilbert-base-uncased')
    model = TFAutoModel.from_pretrained('distilbert-base-uncased')
    embeds = []
    for txt in df['log']:
        inp = tok(txt, return_tensors='tf', truncation=True, padding=True)
        emb = model(inp)[0][:,0,:].numpy().flatten()
        embeds.append(emb)
    emb_df = pd.DataFrame(embeds, index=df.index)
    return pd.concat([df.drop('log',1), emb_df], axis=1)

# 3. Graph Construction via FAISS + NetworkX
def build_knowledge_graph(df: pd.DataFrame, n_neighbors: int = 5) -> nx.Graph:
    feats: np.ndarray = df.drop('ts',1).values.astype('float32')
    idx = faiss.IndexFlatL2(feats.shape[1])
    idx.add(feats)
    D, I = idx.search(feats, n_neighbors+1)
    G = nx.DiGraph()
    for i, nbrs in enumerate(I):
        src = int(df.iloc[i]['user_id'])
        for j in nbrs[1:]:
            dst = int(df.iloc[j]['user_id'])
            G.add_edge(src, dst, weight=float(np.random.rand()))
    return G

# 4. Community Detection
def detect_communities(G: nx.Graph) -> dict:
    comp = nx.algorithms.community.greedy_modularity_communities(G)
    return {n: idx for idx, c in enumerate(comp) for n in c}

# 5. Anomaly Detection on Feature Space
def detect_anomalies(df: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
    iso = IForest(contamination=0.01)
    iso.fit(df.drop('ts',1).values)
    return iso.labels_  # 1 anomaly, 0 normal

# 6. Temporal PCA for Dynamics
def temporal_pca(df: pd.DataFrame, n_comp: int = 3) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df_sorted = df.sort_values('ts')
    vals = df_sorted.drop('ts',1).values
    pca = PCA(n_components=n_comp)
    comp = pca.fit_transform(vals)
    cols = [f'ts_pc{i}' for i in range(1,n_comp+1)]
    return pd.DataFrame(comp, columns=cols, index=df_sorted.index)

# 7. Example Use Cases & Expected Outputs
def example_run():
    df_tab, df_txt, df_net = simulate_data(1000)
    fused: pd.DataFrame = preprocess_and_embed(df_tab, df_txt)
    print("Fused shape:", fused.shape)
    G: nx.Graph = build_knowledge_graph(fused)
    comms: dict = detect_communities(G)
    print("Sample communities:", list(comms.items())[:5])
    anomalies: np.ndarray = detect_anomalies(fused)
    print("Anomalies:", anomalies[:10])
    pca_df: pd.DataFrame = temporal_pca(fused)
    print("PCA comps sample:\n", pca_df.head())

# 8. Key Learnings
# - Multimodal fusion: tabular + text + network streams
# - Scalable autoscaling via Dask & FAISS indexing
# - Graph analytics: community detection & edge weighting
# - Anomaly detection: PyOD IForest on high‑dim features
# - Temporal dynamics: PCA on time series embeddings

Next Steps:

  • Hook into real‑time Kafka/Kinesis ingestion.
  • Deploy graph DB (Neo4j) & expose via REST.
  • Add explainability with SHAP over embeddings.
  • Integrate real user‑behavior logs and enrich with geospatial data.
